item.title: [7.8] US Treasury yields soar most since ‘liberation day’ tariffs shook markets
item.description:

item.title: [6.9] Global Market: BOJ could raise rates to 2% by June 2027 as inflation risks mount: Sakurai
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

The Bank of Japan could raise interest rates every three months and take its policy rate to 2% by June 2027 as inflation pressures build, former BOJ board member Makoto Sakurai said. Higher fuel costs, a weaker yen and strong AI-related demand could push Japanese inflation above 3% through early 2027.

WHY IT MATTERS

A former BOJ board member outlining a specific, aggressive path for rate hikes to 2% provides a valuable directional signal for global bond and currency markets, though it remains a forecast rather than a policy change.
